name: Midnight Rail
summary: A glass sign-in over a snowy night valley, with a night train and a snowy owl that hides its eyes
about: A full sign-in page for a scenic railway: snow falls over pine ridges, constellations turn slowly, and a little train with warm windows crosses a stone bridge above a frozen lake. A snowy owl perched on the card follows your cursor and caret, covers its eyes with its wings for the password and hoots when you sign in. Good for travel, booking and any app that wants a cosy, lively login.
how: The page opens with the card rising in, a branch growing along its top and the owl flying down to land on it
Type your email and the owl swivels its head to follow the caret along the field
Focus the password and the owl covers both eyes with its wings; press the eye button and one wing lifts so it can peek
Press Sign in and a tiny train chugs across the button; a wrong password makes the owl puff up, shake its head and the wind gust
With the demo details the owl spreads its wings and hoots, the train whistles a burst of steam and a boarding pass prints in
Sign out resets the form; move the mouse or scroll to see the pine ridges shift in layers
